sheets.title: Drawing and Document Register
sheets.reading_notes: Full sheet list for RFP 030ADV23Q0282 Attachment J-1. Client: Library of Congress. Project Number: 2212. Stage: Design Development → Final Design. Issue dates range from 4/27/22 through 22/23. RAA (Ralph Appelbaum Associates) is exhibit designer. Client team: Cynthia Wayne, David Mandel, Karen Werth, Raymond Leo. Sheet set spans ~150+ sheets covering: General (X-series), Level 2 Pavilion (X-1100s), Zones 1-2, Zones 3-5, Frieze, Distribution, and Mount Details. BFA role appears to be electrical/MEP subconsultant referenced in power & data sheets and MEP coordination notes.

sheets.title: Notes and Abbreviations
sheets.reading_notes: General notes for exhibit design package. Key notes: (1) exhibit design drawings represent RAA's Stage 4 technical design delivery; (2) contractor to verify all dimensions; (4) drawings not to be appropriated by third parties without RAA permission; (8) all design elements to be verified for compliance with local codes; (9) structural steel: A36; (10) aluminum: AISC spec; (11) contractor to verify all drawings for coordination between trades; (14) all exhibit cases to be lockable and accessible for routine maintenance; (15) AV equipment provided by AV integrator unless noted. Abbreviations list shows HVAC noted (heating, ventilation, A/C) — suggests MEP consultant in the team.

sheets.title: Legend
sheets.reading_notes: Legend sheet showing key plan symbols, exhibit content codes, power plan symbols, floor finishes plan notation, and reflected ceiling plan notation. Exhibit content types: IAV (audio visual), TAC (tactile), SCN (scenic display/model), DSC (display showcase), LAD (live animal display), GTP (graphic treatment - panel), GTR (graphic treatment - reader rail). Power symbols include: single and double power outlets at partition walls at 12" AFFL or 40" AFFL; data outlets; floor-mounted data outlets; ceiling-mounted waterproof double power socket; 'J' outlet to be mounted in exhibit joinery. Ceiling heights noted as 14'-0" (typical) and 12'-0" (closed room). RCP notes: contractor to paint back of house areas black where lighting controls exposed.

sheets.title: Floor Plan Lighting Layout
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 3/16"=1'-0". FINAL DESIGN PHASE. Date 7/14/2023. Drawn: BZ, Checked: AR. Prepared by Lighting Workshop, Brooklyn NY. Shows the full Library of Congress gallery layout at level 1. Two major spaces visible: (left) large circular/octagonal Rotunda Gallery with concentric exhibit cases and totems; (right) long rectangular exhibition hall with multiple casework zones and display walls. All 14 fixture types (F2–F14) distributed across the plan: F2 flexible LED tape in coves; F3 adjustable monopoints in rotunda; F5 linear grazers at totems; F6H/F6W/F6T/F7/F7A/F7B/F11/F12 various casework-mounted track and display fixtures; F8/F13 linear wall-mounted fixtures; F9 inscribed feature wall uplights; F10 window graphic lightboxes; F14 edge-lit reader panels. No square footage dimension directly readable at this scale. Floor plan shows the gallery occupies a significant footprint within the LOC building.
